defect: Reusing tag actions across calls with deleteLater removal leaves the disabled No Tags action alive during the isEmpty check, lets a tag named No Tags collide with the placeholder, and appends new tags unsorted when the database changes.
reason: The old code cleared the menu each time; the incremental update with deferred deletion added here causes the No Tags, name-collision and sort-order bugs the fix repairs.

defect: The Ctrl/Cmd+C selected-text handling was moved into an event filter on QActions, which never fires on macOS, so copying selected text there copies the password instead.
reason: The change removed the previous selected-text logic and its replacement does not work on macOS (Qt behaviour), a regression the fix repairs by handling ShortcutOverride in MainWindow.

defect: sendReply writes the QString length in UTF-16 code units as the message size but sends UTF-8 bytes, so non-ASCII replies get a wrong length prefix.
reason: The new file's sendReply uses reply.length() instead of the UTF-8 byte count, exactly the line the fix changes.

defect: A QSortFilterProxyModel is put between the history view and the model, but view indexes are still passed to m_historyModel without mapToSource, so the wrong history item is shown, restored or deleted after sorting.
reason: The proxy model and the descending sort were added by this change; the fix adds the missing mapToSource calls.

defect: The new data-dir detection requires icons/application/256x256/apps/keepassxc.png and drops the source-dir fallback, so when running from the build directory (whose share folder has no such icon) no data path is found and wordlists/translations are not resolved.
reason: The previous FilePath code fell back to KEEPASSX_SOURCE_DIR/share; the testResourceDir logic added here is what the fix replaces with a plain directory-exists check.

defect: isAvailable() calls getKeyboard() only to test it and never frees the returned XkbDescPtr, leaking it.
reason: The leaking call is in the isAvailable function added by this change; the fix frees the keyboard description.

defect: deleteIndex erases m_historyModifications at index.row(), but that list has one element fewer than the entries, so deleting the last row erases end() (undefined behaviour/crash) and other deletions misalign the modification texts.
reason: The erase line was added by this change; the fix replaces it with a recalculation to fix the crash.

defect: updateStylesheet sets the template QLineEdit { background: %1; } with an unreplaced %1 when passwords match or no base edit exists, producing an invalid stylesheet and Qt parse warnings.
reason: The template string and unconditional setStyleSheet were introduced here; the fix, which names 3b330ee2, only sets a filled stylesheet or an empty one.

defect: truncateHistory allocates foundAttachements with new QList and never deletes it, leaking memory on every call.
reason: The heap allocation was added in this change; the fix turns it into a stack object.

defect: Restart uses QProcess::start(QString), which parses the string as a command line and so fails when the executable path contains spaces (and the child QProcess is never detached).
reason: The restart code was added here; the fix switches to QProcess::startDetached(program, {}).

defect: Markdown detection only accepts text/markdown, but with Qt >= 5.15.18 Markdown files are reported as text/x-web-markdown and are treated as plain text.
reason: The list was added by this change, but whether it was wrong on a Qt version supported at the time or only after a later Qt mime-database change cannot be told from the repository.

defect: Adding toHtmlEscaped to the title, URL and non-coloured password labels double-escapes text in labels that render it as plain text, so characters like & and quotes show as & and ".
reason: The escaping was added here and the fix reverts it, setting explicit text formats instead; seeing the problem needs the labels' text format from other files.

defect: setAllowScreenCapture applies setPreventScreenCapture to every QWindow in qApp->allWindows(), including hidden and non-top-level ones, which creates phantom windows.
reason: The loop was added by this change; the fix restricts it to visible top-level windows, and the side effect depends on the OSUtils implementation.

defect: isEmpty() was changed to return true whenever the edit page is not visible, so an unchanged existing password is reported as empty and an empty password is applied when other key components change.
reason: The changed isEmpty line is exactly what the fix reverts; its effect depends on how the database key settings caller uses isEmpty.

defect: Commenting out parser.process() and dispatching on argv[1] means --help and --version are no longer handled and are reported as invalid commands.
reason: Before this change parser.process handled both options; the fix restores --help/--version handling by parsing the arguments.

defect: saveSettings builds fresh settings (otpUrl false, step always from the spin box), so for an entry with an otp attribute Entry::setTotp overwrites it with step;digits text, destroying the key, and a custom step leaks into default mode.
reason: The createSettings call without the previous settings was added in this refactor; the fix passes the previous settings and uses the step only for custom mode, and the corruption is visible only with Entry::setTotp and writeSettings.

defect: GUI_LaunchAtStartup is guarded by KEEPASSXC_DIST_FLATPAK in Config.h and Config.cpp, but neither includes config-keepassx.h, so the key is missing from the table and the enum layout differs between translation units in Flatpak builds.
reason: The #ifdef guards were added by this change and the fix removes them; seeing the missing macro needs the include structure of Config.h and Global.h.

defect: new QAction(icon, text) without a parent argument does not compile with Qt 5.6, where the parent parameter has no default.
reason: The project still accepted Qt 5.2+ at the time, so this new code broke the build on a supported Qt; the fix adds an explicit nullptr parent.

defect: StringField::operator= assigns m_key = m_key and m_value = m_value, so assignment copies nothing.
reason: The self-assignment was written in this change; the fix assigns from other.

defect: The delegate's size hint grows with the list widget's current width and sizeHint feeds that back into the widget width, so the category list keeps resizing itself.
reason: The width-dependent sizeHint/minimumSizeHint logic was introduced here; the same-day fix replaces it to stop the resizing bug.

defect: The database widget's closeRequest signal is connected to closeDatabase(), which closes the current tab, instead of closeDatabaseFromSender(), so the wrong database can be closed.
reason: This change added both the connect and the unused closeDatabaseFromSender slot; the fix connects the right slot.

defect: lockDatabases compares numLocked with count() after closing file-less tabs, so it returns false even when all databases were locked and closeAllDatabaseTabs aborts.
reason: The return value and comparison were added in this change; the fix compares with the tab count taken before the loop.

defect: The new config key SearchWaitForEnter is added to the enum but never registered in Config.cpp's key table, so the Press Enter to search setting is not saved.
reason: The key was introduced by this change without its configStrings entry; the fix renames it and adds the mapping in Config.cpp.

defect: markAsModified no longer checks whether modified signals are enabled and always starts the modified timer, so modifications while emitting is blocked still emit databaseModified, causing endless saves with autosave after failed saves.
reason: The removed m_emitModified check is in this change; the fix (which names #6438) restores the modifiedSignalEnabled() check.

defect: update() only hides the password generator and resets its toggle when no group is set, and never resets the show-password toggle, so generator and visibility state carry over to the next edited group.
reason: The fix moves these resets out of the null-group branch and adds the show-password reset in code written by this change; seeing it needs to know the widget is reused across group edits.

defect: loadSettings sets lockDatabaseOnScreenLockCheckBox from IconDownloadFallbackToGoogle instead of fallbackToGoogle, so the screen-lock setting is overwritten and the Google fallback checkbox is never loaded.
reason: The wrong widget name is in the line added by this change and is corrected by the fix.

defect: if (!fileKey.load(...), &errorMsg) misplaces the parenthesis, so the error string is not passed and the condition is the always-true comma expression.
reason: The misplaced parenthesis was written in this new file; the fix moves it.

defect: int(QThread::currentThreadId()) casts a 64-bit pointer handle to int, which does not compile with GCC on MSYS2 Windows.
reason: The cast was introduced by this change; the next-day fix uses reinterpret_cast to qlonglong to fix the MSYS build.

defect: The Run registry value is set to the unquoted applicationFilePath with forward slashes, so autostart fails when the path contains spaces.
reason: setLaunchAtStartup was added here; the fix quotes the path and converts it to native separators.

defect: deserialize reads the old Trusted attribute instead of the Trust attribute that serialize writes, treats a nonzero compare() as a match, misspells Untrusted and lets the else overwrite the Trusted case, so trust values do not round-trip.
reason: All of these errors are in lines this change wrote; the fix corrects the attribute name, the comparisons and the spelling.

defect: The benchmark lambda captures this without using it, which is an unused-lambda-capture warning that breaks the -Werror build with clang.
reason: The [this, kdf] capture was added in this change and the build used -Wall -Werror; the fix removes this from the capture.

defect: The browser socket name is built from the KPXC_QUALIFIED_APPNAME application property, which differs or is missing in keepassxc-proxy, so the proxy and the app use different socket paths.
reason: localServerPath was introduced in this refactor and the fix hardcodes the server name; the mismatch needs the proxy's application setup to see.

defect: For a password plus key file, rawKey hashes the raw password bytes together with the key file data instead of the SHA-256 of the password, giving the wrong composite key.
reason: The composite-key code is in this new file and the fix hashes the password first, as in the password-only branch.

defect: setWindowFlags is called after show/activateWindow/raise, which hides and re-creates the dialog so the association popup does not appear on some window managers.
reason: The misplaced setWindowFlags line was added here; the fix moves it before show().

defect: searchEntries always skips entries whose URL scheme differs from the request's (including entries stored without a scheme), ignoring the Match URL scheme setting.
reason: The unconditional scheme check was added by this change; the fix makes it depend on BrowserSettings::matchUrlScheme().

defect: updateMasterKey closes the database when the user cancels and the database does have a key, the inverse of the previous no-key check.
reason: The inverted condition was introduced in this change; the fix negates it.

defect: handleURL matches when the site host merely ends with the entry host, so an entry for example.com matches a site like badexample.com and credentials are offered to another domain.
reason: The endsWith check was rewritten in this change; the fix adds a base-domain equality check to it.

defect: saveDatabaseAs overwrites dbStruct.lockFile with a new QLockFile without deleting the old one (leaking it and keeping the old file locked) and ignores a failed tryLock on the target.
reason: The lock-file code in saveDatabaseAs was added by this change; the fix deletes the old lock, checks the new one and handles errors.

defect: openUrlForEntry now uses QUrl(entry->url()) instead of webUrl(), so URLs without a scheme such as example.com are parsed as relative paths and do not open in the browser.
reason: The switch to plain QUrl construction is in this change; the fix uses QUrl::fromUserInput.

defect: Info.cpp uses asConst without including core/Global.h, so it fails to compile on platforms where the header is not pulled in transitively.
reason: The missing include is in this new file; the fix adds core/Global.h, and seeing it needs knowing where asConst is defined.
